snippet_primary: "I paid $198 for \"unlimited\" AI generations. I got 10.  I subscribed to Envato's annual plan precisely because it offered unlimited AI generations. The pitch was clear: one subscription, all the creative assets you need, AI tools included. I bought in. I paid upfront.  Then, after my money was safely in their pocket, they pulled the rug."
subject_exact: Envato annual subscriber paid $198 for plan advertised as unlimited AI generations; allocation reduced to 10 after payment secured, characterized as bait-and-switch
